# `openai_chat_completions_to_vertexai_gemini`

Transforms OpenAI Chat Completions requests into Vertex AI Gemini `generateContent` format and translates responses back.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `project` | string | yes | GCP project ID used to construct the Vertex AI endpoint path. |
| `region` | string | no | GCP region for the Vertex AI endpoint path. |
| `max_body_bytes` | integer | no | Maximum body size in bytes for `StreamBuffer` mode. |

## Examples

### Example 1

```yaml
filter: openai_chat_completions_to_vertexai_gemini
project: my-gcp-project
```

### Example 2

```yaml
filter: openai_chat_completions_to_vertexai_gemini
project: my-gcp-project
region: us-central1
max_body_bytes: 1048576
```
